title: Cell adhesion assay to determine the interaction between NGL-3 with LAR cell adhesion molecules
protocol: Prepare L cells at 50% confluency in 6-well plates.
Transfect a group of L cells with 1 μg of NGL-3 and 0.5 μg of EGFP using the lipofectamine method.
Transfect another group of L cells with 1 μg of LAR and 0.5 μg of DsRed.
Wash L cells twice with PBS after transfection.
Treat L cells with trypsin to detach them from the plate.
Add 2 ml of DMEM containing 10% fetal bovine serum to inactivate trypsin.
Spin down the L cells at 1,000 rpm for 5 min.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 ml of serum-free DMEM to disperse cells.
Incubate 500 μl of the cell suspension in a microtube for 1 hour at room temperature.
Mix 500 μl of NGL-3-expressing cells with 500 μl of LAR-expressing cells and incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer 100 μl of the cell mixture to a well containing 400 μl of serum-free DMEM on a culture slide.
Capture Z-stacked images by confocal microscopy using a 20x objective lens.
Count the number of cell aggregates from a single Z-stacked frame. Cell aggregates are defined as groups of four or more clustered cells that contain at least one red and green cell.
